sources.title: BDEW Standardlastprofile Strom 2025
sources.attribution: BDEW Bundesverband der Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft e.V., 2025. Publicly provided representative profiles; no open-data licence asserted.
sources.transformation: Four quarter-hour energy values summed per hour. Household dynamization applied at runtime according to BDEW 17 March 2025 guidance, page 4. P25/S25 are excluded.

sources.title: Regression-based electricity load profiles of 32 industrial and commercial sub-sectors in Germany
sources.authors: Stephan Seim, Daniel Ruedt, Qi Wu, Maike Held, Paul Verwiebe, Joachim Mueller-Kirchenbauer
sources.transformation: 2018 weighted German mean profiles: normalize each branch by its annual mean, then average by month, weekday and clock hour. German holiday/weather effects remain in those averages. No disaggregator code reused.
